messages:
Sara P: Hey @eng-infra — opened a PR that adds a new nullable JSONB column `stream_source` to events.streams and a best-effort background backfill job. Need 1-2 quick reviews + :thumbsup: to merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/PT-4217  
Mike: :eyes: Will review after standup, should be quick.
Raj: Can you paste the ALTER + backfill snippet here so I can check for locks?
Sara P: Sure — main DDL is simple (nullable, no default) so it should be instant: 
```sql
ALTER TABLE events.streams ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stream_source JSONB;
```
Backfill job runs in batches (commits per batch) to avoid long transactions:  
```sql
-- pseudocode
INSERT INTO migrations.stream_backfills (shard, last_id) VALUES (1, 0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
LOOP
  UPDATE events.streams SET stream_source = derived_value
  WHERE id > last_id AND id <= last_id + 1000;
  -- record progress and commit
END LOOP;
```
Estimated backfill time: ~3 hours across all shards, canary on shard-03 first.
Oliver: Adding a nullable JSONB without a default is cheap — good. Make sure no implicit rewrite.
Danielle: We should have a rollback/resume plan in case the backfill stalls. Is the job idempotent?
Sara P: Yes — job checkpoints progress in migrations.stream_backfills; it's idempotent and resumes from last_id. I'll add explicit resume endpoints in the job code.
Raj: One thing: index creation. We should NOT create a JSONB GIN index until backfill completes; use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` in a follow-up PR.
Sara P: Agreed — I'll split index into PT-4218 follow-up.
Kevin: I can run the canary deploy on shard-03 and watch metrics. If we get 2 approvals I can merge and run canary at 03:00 UTC.
Mike: Approved. :thumbsup:
Oliver: Approved with one doc nit (fix PR description to include backfill duration).
Raj: Left a small comment about batching size; otherwise OK.
Danielle: Also ensure the backfill worker respects job TTLs and backpressure so it doesn't starve real-time pipelines.
Sara P: Good catch — backfill uses a lower priority queue and rate limit. I'll add that to the runbook.
infra-bot: Reminder: If this changes DB schema, file a change in the DB catalog and schedule a maintenance window if needed.
Sara P: Filed DB catalog entry and added runbook section. Will include rollback steps and index follow-up.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Kevin for 2026-05-02T03:00:00Z on shard-03 (canary).
Kevin: I'll run the canary and slack updates. Assigning merge to me after final approves.
Sara P: Thanks all — I'll address Raj's batching comment and add the runbook + resume endpoint. Will ping when updates are pushed. :pray:
